topArticle.title: Costa Rican diplomat emerges as strong contender to be first female head of UN

Rebeca Grynspan seen as continuity candidate with tacit support from current secretary general, António Guterres
A Costa Rican diplomat and former vice-president whose parents were refugees from the Holocaust has become the surprise frontrunner to lead the United Nations as its first female secretary general.
Rebeca Grynspan, whose parents emigrated to Central America from Poland – and whose maternal grandparents were killed by the Nazis – is the current head of the UN conference on trade and development (UNCTAD), a body that has exhaustively tallied the economic damage inflicted by Israel’s occupation of the Palestinian territories.

topArticle.summary: ベネズエラで地震発生から1ヶ月が経ち、住民は行方不明の家族を探し続け、当局への怒りと不満を募らせている。

topArticle.title: I was standing in front of my teacher when she was shot, Thai pupil says
topArticle.description: The student says she feared never seeing her mother again after the attack killed five teachers.
topArticle.titleJa: 教師が撃たれた時、私はその目の前に立っていた、とタイの生徒が語る
topArticle.summary: タイでの襲撃事件で教師5人が死亡。ある生徒は、事件時教師の目の前にいて、もう母親に会えないのではと恐れたと語った。

topArticle.title: Why was Taiwan’s president evacuated in the middle of the night?
topArticle.description: President William Lai took part in an emergency evacuation drill as part of Taiwan military exercises preparing for a potential Chinese invasion.
topArticle.titleJa: 台湾総統はなぜ真夜中に避難したのか？
topArticle.summary: 頼総統は、中国による潜在的侵攻に備えた台湾軍事演習の一環として、緊急避難訓練に参加した。

topArticle.title: South Korea space agency shares Moon images after SpaceX rocket debris crash
topArticle.description: Seoul's lunar orbiter captured images of the Moon before and after part of SpaceX's rocket hit its surface on Wednesday.
topArticle.titleJa: スペースXロケット残骸衝突後、韓国宇宙機関が月の画像を共有
topArticle.summary: スペースXロケットの一部が月に衝突した後、韓国の月探査機が衝突前後の月の画像を公開した。

topArticle.title: United Kingdom launches safeguard investigation on polyethylene terephthalate
topArticle.description: On 5 August 2026, the United Kingdom notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day, a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate (PET).
topArticle.titleJa: 英国、ポリエチレンテレフタレートに関するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: 英国は2026年8月5日、ポリエチレンテレフタレートの輸入に関するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。

topArticle.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
topArticle.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
topArticle.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコによるEVなどの車両に関する措置について報告書を発行
topArticle.summary: WTOは7月28日、中国が提起した「トルコ—中国からの電気自動車などに関する措置」のパネル報告書を回覧した。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、開発途上国および後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上に3万ユーロを供与
topArticle.summary: リトアニアは2026年に3万ユーロを拠出し、開発途上国および後発開発途上国の政府職員向け貿易研修プログラムを支援する。

topArticle.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
topArticle.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
topArticle.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年WTO加盟目標を再確認し、継続的な関与に感謝
topArticle.summary: ウズベキスタンは7月27～28日の作業部会で、2026年までのWTO加盟完了への決意を再確認し、加盟国に感謝を表明した。
